description.zh: 视角向左转动并朝相邻门框/门洞靠近，卫生间门逐渐移到画面右侧；这些帧仍未显示已穿过卧室门，也未显示任务要求的电视与床的关系。
description.en: The view pans left and approaches an adjacent doorway/frame while the bathroom door shifts to the right; these frames still do not show passage through the bedroom door or the required TV-and-bed arrangement.

description.zh: B 处近处白墙/隔断占据主要画面，左侧只局部露出疑似凳子或梳妆台类家具；镜子、电视和床均无法确认。
description.en: At B, a close white wall or partition fills most of the view, with only a partial piece of furniture resembling a stool or vanity visible on the left; a mirror, TV, and bed cannot be confirmed.

uncertainties.zh: 左侧门洞是否确为卧室入口，以及机器人是否已穿过该门洞进入卧室。
uncertainties.en: Whether the doorway on the left is indeed the bedroom entrance, and whether the robot has passed through it into the bedroom.

uncertainties.zh: 途中是否实际经过左侧的电视和右侧的床。
uncertainties.en: Whether the robot actually passed the TV on its left and the bed on its right en route.

uncertainties.zh: B 处左侧家具是否为任务所指的带镜梳妆台，以及机器人是否已停在其正前方。
uncertainties.en: Whether the furniture on the left at B is the instructed vanity with a mirror, and whether the robot has stopped directly in front of it.
